name: Lithium-Ion / Rechargeable Batteries
summary: Never put these in your Blue or Black cart; they spark landfill and truck fires.
instructions: Tape the terminals with electrical or duct tape before dropping off.

locations.name: The Home Depot (Call2Recycle Bins)
locations.notes: Collection box usually located near customer service or the entrance.

locations.name: City of Chicago Household Chemicals & Computer Recycling Facility (HCCRF)
locations.address: 1150 N North Branch St, Chicago, IL 60642

name: Alkaline Batteries (Single-Use AA, AAA, 9V)
summary: Standard single-use alkaline batteries are non-hazardous in Illinois and go in normal trash.
instructions: Place in your standard black cart/dumpster. City facilities do not recycle alkaline batteries.

name: Latex / Water-Based Paint
summary: Latex paint is non-hazardous and is NOT accepted at the Goose Island city facility.
instructions: Must be dried completely before disposal. Add kitty litter or paint hardener. Leave lid off and place inside the Black Cart.

name: Oil-Based Paint, Stains & Solvents
summary: Hazardous waste. Illegal to dump in curbside bins or down city drains.
instructions: Keep in original labeled containers. Drive through drop-off at Goose Island.

locations.name: Chicago HCCRF (Goose Island)
locations.address: 1150 N North Branch St, Chicago, IL 60642

name: Plastic Shopping Bags & Film
summary: Number 1 contaminant in Chicago recycling. They tangle sorting machinery at the processing plant.
instructions: Do not bag your recyclables. Bring clean, dry bags back to collection bins at local grocery stores.

locations.name: Jewel-Osco / Mariano's Entrance Bins
locations.notes: Look for plastic film recycling bins in the vestibule.

name: Cardboard Pizza Box
summary: Grease and food oils ruin paper pulp batches during recycling.
instructions: Tear the box in half: clean top lid goes in the Blue Cart; greasy bottom goes into trash or food scrap compost.

name: Plastics #1, #2, #3, #4, #5
summary: Accepted in Chicago curbside Blue Carts if empty, clean, and dry.
instructions: Rinse out food residue. Re-attach plastic lids/caps so they do not get lost in sorting screens.

name: Styrofoam / Polystyrene Foam (#6)
summary: Not accepted in Chicago Blue Carts under any circumstance.
instructions: Place in regular trash. For clean block foam, look for specialized seasonal ward drop-off events.
